principle: external-owner-first; observation is not interpretation, decision, or execution authority

usTreasuryNominalCurve.authorityBoundary: official Treasury daily par yield curve; not intraday cash-Treasury market data

usTreasuryRealCurve.authorityBoundary: official Treasury daily par real yield curve; not intraday TIPS market data

brentWti.credentialPolicy: do not scrape or invent a key; integrate only after an owner-supplied EIA API key is admitted
brentWti.authorityBoundary: official EIA daily petroleum series; not exchange-grade intraday Brent/WTI execution truth

fedPolicyRepricing.credentialPolicy: do not scrape the FedWatch web UI; integrate the official API after subscription credentials exist
fedPolicyRepricing.authorityBoundary: market-implied FOMC target-rate probabilities; not a Federal Reserve forecast or policy commitment
